newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins 650 mln SKR Nordic order.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins 650 mln SKR Nordic order.

text.p: Swedish telecommunications firm LM Ericsson AB said on Monday it won an order worth 650 million crowns exluding options for radar equipment in Norway and Sweden.
Ericsson won the order for the artillery searching system Arthur from Norwegian and Swedish army equipment authorities, the company said in a statement.
The radar systems will be delivered by Ericsson Radar in Halden, Norway, the company said.
Deliveries will start in 1998 and will be finalised in the year 2000, the company said.
The system has received international attention and talks regarding acquisitions are underway with countries in Europe, Asia and Latin America, the company said.
The company did not disclose how many systems the order encompassed.
